title: Start the 2-week eval only after 3 LIT non-winners in a row (config A0)
question: Owner order 2026-10-18: does LIT's own state tell when to buy the eval (causal rules only)?
verdict: Not proven. Starting after 3 non-winning LIT trades in a row lowers 2-week fails for every config in both halves and raises H2 passes, but the samples are 53 (H1) and 27 (H2) overlapping starts, 2021-25 shows no gain, the back-to-back path is mixed, and waiting for the streak costs calendar time. Starting right after a LIT target is the worst H2 start (21-29%) but the best H1 start (56-70%).
